extractions.value: Antecedent ocular myasthenia gravis, thymus hyperplasia, HLA phenotype A2,B46,Cwl,Cw7,DR6,DR8
extractions.quote: She had a history of myasthenia gravis at the age of 12; she was noticed to have drooping eyelids while staring at objects and the ocular type of myasthenia gravis was diagnosed at another institution by the positive anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody (anti-AChR Ab) 0.7 pmol/7 and by the findings of EMG indicating a progressive diminution in the amplitude of the action potentials evoked in the hypothenar muscle at the wrist during repetitive stimulation of 3 MHz which resulted in 10% reduction from the initial value and was reversed by edrophonium administration. Myasthenia was restricted to the ocular muscles for one year and thereafter improved spontaneously. The computed tomography of the chest showed the questionable hyperplasia of the thymus (Fig.2). The HLA phenotype was A2, B46, Cwl, Cw7, DR6 and DR8.
